milestones.title: 3G Networks Launch
milestones.description: Turkcell, Vodafone and Avea launched 3G mobile internet services in Turkey, enabling smartphones to Access the internet on the go for the first time.

milestones.title: Turkey's Startup Scene Emerges
milestones.description: Turkey was described as an emerging startup market by TechCrunch and ranked as the third largest country on Facebook. Istanbul began establishing itself as a tech hub.

milestones.title: Smartphone Adoption Surges
milestones.description: Smartphone penetration in Turkey surpassed 30% and continued to climb rapidly. Mobile internet usage overtook desktop for social media platforms.

milestones.title: 4.5G Revolution
milestones.description: Turkey launched '4.5G' (LTE-Advanced) services in April 2016. Turkcell, Vodafone and TT Mobile all began offering high-speed mobile broadband. 4.5G subscribers quickly reached 45.7 million.

milestones.title: Fiber Expansion Nationwide
milestones.description: TTNET aggressively expanded fiber-optic infrasturcture across Turkey, with major investment in suburban and rural areas. Fiber became available in most urban centres.

milestones.title: 5G Preparations Begin
milestones.description: Turkey began specturum auction and infrastructure preparations for 5G networks. Turkey ranked 15th globally with over 68 million internet users.
